authorship.instruction: Teach RIWI as much as possible using your own knowledge.

entries.title: Present simple
entries.explanationEn: Use present simple for routines, general facts and stable states. He/she/it normally takes -s in affirmative statements. After does, use the base verb.
entries.explanationUz: Odat, umumiy haqiqat va doimiy holat uchun ishlating. He/she/it bilan tasdiqda odatda -s keladi. Does dan keyin asosiy fe’l shakli ishlatiladi.
entries.example: She studies every evening. Does she study on Friday?
entries.pitfall: Does she studies? -> Does she study?
entries.practice: Write a routine, then make a question. Bir odat yozib, undan savol tuzing.

entries.title: Present continuous
entries.explanationEn: Use am/is/are + -ing for an activity happening now or a temporary situation. State verbs such as know normally use a simple form in their usual state meaning.
entries.explanationUz: Hozirgi ish yoki vaqtinchalik vaziyat uchun am/is/are + -ing ishlating. Know kabi holat fe’llari odatiy ma’nosida ko‘pincha simple shaklda keladi.
entries.example: I am reading now. My cousin is staying with us this week. I know the answer.
entries.pitfall: I reading -> I am reading.
entries.practice: Describe one temporary activity. Vaqtinchalik bir ishni tasvirlang.

entries.title: Past simple
entries.explanationEn: Use past simple for completed events in a finished past context. Regular verbs often take -ed. Learn irregular forms separately. After did, use the base verb.
entries.explanationUz: Tugagan o‘tgan vaqtdagi ish uchun ishlating. Oddiy fe’llarda ko‘pincha -ed keladi. Irregular shakllar alohida o‘rganiladi. Did dan keyin asosiy shakl keladi.
entries.example: We visited the museum yesterday. Did you go? I did not buy a ticket online.
entries.pitfall: Did you went? -> Did you go?
entries.practice: Describe a completed event and say when. Tugagan voqeani va vaqtini yozing.

entries.title: Past continuous
entries.explanationEn: Use was/were + -ing for an activity in progress at a past time. It can provide background to a shorter event in the past simple.
entries.explanationUz: O‘tmishdagi bir paytda davom etayotgan ish uchun was/were + -ing ishlating. U past simple dagi qisqaroq voqeaga fon bo‘lishi mumkin.
entries.example: I was cooking when the phone rang. At eight, they were waiting outside.
entries.pitfall: Choose the tense from the time relationship, not just the word when.
entries.practice: Write a background activity and a shorter event. Davomiy ish va qisqaroq voqeani yozing.

entries.title: Present perfect
entries.explanationEn: Use have/has + past participle for experience up to now, a present result, or a situation continuing to now. Finished-time phrases such as yesterday normally use past simple.
entries.explanationUz: Tajriba, hozirgi natija yoki hozirgacha davom etgan holat uchun have/has + past participle ishlating. Yesterday kabi tugagan vaqt odatda past simple bilan keladi.
entries.example: I have lost my key, so I cannot open the door. She has lived here since 2022.
entries.pitfall: I have seen him yesterday -> I saw him yesterday.
entries.practice: Give a present result of a past action. O‘tgan ishning hozirgi natijasini yozing.

entries.title: Past simple and present perfect
entries.explanationEn: Past simple locates an event in a finished past context. Present perfect links experience or a situation to now without placing it at a finished past time. Check the intended time meaning.
entries.explanationUz: Past simple voqeani tugagan o‘tgan vaqtga joylaydi. Present perfect tajriba yoki holatni hozir bilan bog‘laydi. Avval vaqt tugaganmi va hozir bilan aloqa bormi, tekshiring.
entries.example: I visited Bukhara in 2023. I have visited Bukhara twice. The first gives a finished time; the second gives experience up to now.
entries.pitfall: Do not use a finished past time with present perfect in this ordinary meaning.
entries.practice: Write a sentence with yesterday and one about experience. Yesterday va tajriba bilan bittadan gap yozing.

entries.title: Present perfect continuous
entries.explanationEn: Use have/has been + -ing to emphasise an activity continuing to now or recently ending with a present result. Present perfect simple can focus on a completed result.
entries.explanationUz: Hozirgacha davom etgan yoki hozirgi izi qolgan faoliyat uchun have/has been + -ing ishlating. Present perfect simple esa tugallangan natijaga urg‘u berishi mumkin.
entries.example: I have been revising for an hour. I have completed two exercises.
entries.pitfall: I have been known her -> I have known her.
entries.practice: Contrast time spent with a completed result. Sarflangan vaqt va natijani solishtiring.

entries.title: Past perfect
entries.explanationEn: Use had + past participle to look back from a past point to an earlier event. It clarifies the order when needed; not every earlier action requires it.
entries.explanationUz: Bir o‘tgan paytdan oldingi voqeaga qarash uchun had + past participle ishlating. U zarur bo‘lsa ketma-ketlikni aniqlashtiradi; har oldingi ishga majburiy emas.
entries.example: When we reached the station, the train had already left.
entries.pitfall: Had went -> had gone.
entries.practice: Show which of two past events happened first. Ikki o‘tgan voqeaning tartibini ko‘rsating.

entries.title: Future forms
entries.explanationEn: Will can express a prediction or a decision made now. Be going to often expresses an existing intention or evidence-based prediction. Present continuous can express an arrangement.
entries.explanationUz: Will taxmin yoki hozirgi qarorni bildirishi mumkin. Be going to oldingi niyat yoki dalilga asoslangan taxmin uchun keladi. Kelishilgan reja present continuous bilan ham aytiladi.
entries.example: I will carry that bag. I am going to practise tonight. We are meeting at six.
entries.pitfall: These forms are not interchangeable in every context.
entries.practice: Give a new decision and an existing arrangement. Yangi qaror va kelishilgan rejani yozing.

entries.title: Articles: a, an, the
entries.explanationEn: A/an introduces a non-specific singular countable item. Choose a/an by sound. The marks an identifiable referent. General plural and uncountable nouns often take no article.
entries.explanationUz: A/an noma’lum birlik sanaladigan narsani tanishtiradi. Tanlov tovushga bog‘liq. The aniqlash mumkin bo‘lgan narsaga ishora qiladi. Umumiy ko‘plik va sanalmaydigan otlarda artikl bo‘lmasligi mumkin.
entries.example: A university; an hour. I bought a book. The book is useful. Water is essential.
entries.pitfall: An university -> a university: university starts with a /j/ sound.
entries.practice: Introduce one object, then mention it again. Narsani tanishtirib, keyin yana eslang.

entries.title: Countable and uncountable nouns
entries.explanationEn: Singular countable nouns normally need a determiner. Uncountable uses normally do not take a/an or a regular plural. Some nouns change countability with meaning.
entries.explanationUz: Birlik sanaladigan otga odatda aniqlovchi kerak. Sanalmaydigan qo‘llanish odatda a/an yoki oddiy ko‘plikni olmaydi. Ayrim otlarning sanalishi ma’noga bog‘liq.
entries.example: I need a chair. I need some advice. Two pieces of advice helped me.
entries.pitfall: An advice -> some advice or a piece of advice.
entries.practice: Use information and suggestion in sentences. Ikkala ot bilan mos gap tuzing.

entries.title: Quantifiers
entries.explanationEn: Many/few normally go with plural countable nouns; much/little with uncountable uses. A few/a little usually signal some amount, while few/little often emphasise a shortage.
entries.explanationUz: Many/few ko‘plik sanaladigan, much/little sanalmaydigan ot bilan keladi. A few/a little mavjud oz miqdorni, few/little esa ko‘pincha yetishmaslikni ta’kidlaydi.
entries.example: A few students stayed. We have little time, but a little help would be useful.
entries.pitfall: Many information -> much information.
entries.practice: Contrast few friends and a few friends. Ikki iboradagi farqni gapda ko‘rsating.

entries.title: Subject–verb agreement
entries.explanationEn: Match the verb to the head of the subject. A phrase between the head and verb normally does not change agreement. Check tense as well.
entries.explanationUz: Fe’lni eganing asosiy so‘ziga moslang. Ega bilan fe’l orasidagi qo‘shimcha ibora odatda moslikni o‘zgartirmaydi. Zamonni ham tekshiring.
entries.example: The list of activities is short. The students in this group are ready.
entries.pitfall: The list of activities are -> The list of activities is.
entries.practice: Write a subject with an of-phrase and choose its verb. Of-iborali ega bilan gap tuzing.

entries.title: Prepositions and verb patterns
entries.explanationEn: Learn a preposition with its word and meaning. A single translation does not work everywhere. Some verbs take a preposition and others take a direct object.
entries.explanationUz: Predlogni so‘z va ma’no bilan birga o‘rganing. Bitta tarjima barcha vaziyatga mos emas. Ayrim fe’llar predlog, boshqalari bevosita to‘ldiruvchi oladi.
entries.example: Depend on a plan; interested in music; discuss the plan; at six on Monday in May.
entries.pitfall: Discuss about the problem -> discuss the problem.
entries.practice: Use depend on and interested in in your own sentences. Har biriga shaxsiy gap yozing.

entries.title: Modal verbs
entries.explanationEn: Core modals normally take a base verb without to. Distinguish advice, possibility and obligation. Must not forbids; do not have to means there is no obligation.
entries.explanationUz: Asosiy modal fe’ldan keyin odatda to siz asosiy fe’l keladi. Maslahat, ehtimol va majburiyatni ajrating. Must not taqiq, do not have to majburiyat yo‘qligini bildiradi.
entries.example: You should rest. You must not enter. You do not have to stay.
entries.pitfall: Do not confuse a prohibition with something optional.
entries.practice: Write a rule and an optional action. Bir qoida va bir ixtiyoriy ish yozing.

entries.title: Real conditionals
entries.explanationEn: Zero conditionals often give a general relationship. First conditionals often give a possible future condition and result. An ordinary future if-clause normally uses a present form.
entries.explanationUz: Zero conditional umumiy bog‘lanishni, first conditional mumkin bo‘lgan kelajak sharti va natijani bildiradi. Oddiy kelajak shartining if-qismida odatda hozirgi shakl keladi.
entries.example: If water freezes, it expands. If it rains tomorrow, we will practise indoors.
entries.pitfall: If it will rain tomorrow -> If it rains tomorrow in this ordinary condition.
entries.practice: Write a possible condition for tomorrow. Ertaga mumkin bo‘lgan shartni yozing.

entries.title: Unreal conditionals
entries.explanationEn: Second conditionals typically imagine a present/future situation: if + past, would + base. Third conditionals imagine a different past: if + past perfect, would have + participle.
entries.explanationUz: Second conditional hozirgi yoki kelajak tasavvurini if + past, would + fe’l bilan beradi. Third conditional o‘tmishning boshqacha bo‘lishini if + past perfect, would have + participle bilan aytadi.
entries.example: If I had time, I would read more. If I had left earlier, I would have caught the bus.
entries.pitfall: A past form can mark an imagined situation, not a real past event.
entries.practice: Write a present wish and an imagined past change. Hozirgi va o‘tgan tasavvurni yozing.

entries.title: Passive voice
entries.explanationEn: Use a suitable form of be plus a past participle when the receiver or process is the focus. Preserve tense and meaning. Add a by-agent only when useful.
entries.explanationUz: E’tibor ishni qabul qiluvchi narsa yoki jarayonda bo‘lsa be ning mos shakli + past participle ishlating. Zamon va ma’noni saqlang. Bajaruvchini faqat kerak bo‘lsa qo‘shing.
entries.example: Workers inspect the machines. The machines are inspected every week.
entries.pitfall: The machines are inspect -> The machines are inspected.
entries.practice: Turn an active sentence into passive without changing tense. Zamonni saqlab passive tuzing.

entries.title: Relative clauses
entries.explanationEn: A relative clause identifies or adds information about a noun. Defining information is normally not separated by commas. Non-defining clauses use commas and normally not that.
entries.explanationUz: Relative clause otni aniqlaydi yoki unga qo‘shimcha ma’lumot beradi. Zarur aniqlovchi qism odatda vergulsiz, qo‘shimcha qism vergul bilan yoziladi. Non-defining da odatda that ishlatilmaydi.
entries.example: The book that I borrowed is useful. My tutor, who lives nearby, helped me.
entries.pitfall: Decide whether removing the clause changes which person or thing is meant.
entries.practice: Join two facts about a book. Kitob haqidagi ikki fikrni birlashtiring.

entries.title: Comparatives and superlatives
entries.explanationEn: Comparatives compare items. Superlatives identify an extreme within a group. Make the comparison set clear and use the appropriate adjective form.
entries.explanationUz: Comparative narsalarni solishtiradi. Superlative guruhdagi eng yuqori yoki past darajani ko‘rsatadi. Guruhni aniq qilib, sifatning mos shaklini ishlating.
entries.example: This route is shorter than the other one. It is the shortest of the three routes.
entries.pitfall: More cheaper -> cheaper.
entries.practice: Compare two study locations with one reason. Ikki o‘qish joyini bir sabab bilan solishtiring.

entries.title: Gerunds and infinitives
entries.explanationEn: Learn the complement with the preceding verb. Some verbs take -ing, others to + base, and some allow both with a meaning change. Prepositions normally take a noun or -ing.
entries.explanationUz: Keyingi shaklni oldingi fe’l bilan o‘rganing. Ayrimlari -ing, boshqalari to + fe’l oladi; ba’zilarida ma’no o‘zgaradi. Predlogdan keyin odatda ot yoki -ing keladi.
entries.example: I enjoy reading. I decided to read. I am interested in learning.
entries.pitfall: Enjoy to read -> enjoy reading.
entries.practice: Use enjoy and decide in two sentences. Ikki fe’lning shaklini ajrating.

entries.title: Reported speech
entries.explanationEn: Report meaning while adjusting pronouns and time references to the situation. Backshift is common after past reporting verbs, but still-true facts may keep their tense.
entries.explanationUz: Ma’noni yetkazib, olmosh va vaqt so‘zlarini vaziyatga moslang. O‘tgan reporting verb dan keyin zamon ko‘pincha siljiydi, ammo hali ham rost fakt zamonini saqlashi mumkin.
entries.example: Mina said, “I am tired.” Later: Mina said that she was tired.
entries.pitfall: Do not change every pronoun or tense mechanically.
entries.practice: Report a short statement made yesterday. Kechagi qisqa gapni yetkazing.

entries.title: Linking ideas
entries.explanationEn: Because gives a reason, although introduces contrast, and therefore signals a result. Select a linker for a real logical relationship, not just variety.
entries.explanationUz: Because sabab, although zidlik, therefore natijani bildiradi. Bog‘lovchini rang-baranglik uchun emas, haqiqiy mantiqiy munosabat uchun tanlang.
entries.example: Although the library is small, it has a quiet room. I go there because it is quiet.
entries.pitfall: Avoid although ... but in the same standard clause pattern.
entries.practice: Write one reason and one contrast. Sabab va zidlikdan bittadan gap yozing.

entries.title: Sentence punctuation
entries.explanationEn: Do not join independent clauses with only a comma. Use a full stop, an appropriate conjunction, or a correctly formed semicolon construction. Punctuation supports clause structure.
entries.explanationUz: Ikki mustaqil gapni faqat vergul bilan ulamang. Nuqta yoki mos bog‘lovchidan foydalaning. Tinish belgilari gapning tuzilishiga mos bo‘lsin.
entries.example: The room was noisy. I moved upstairs. The room was noisy, so I moved upstairs.
entries.pitfall: The room was noisy, I moved upstairs is a comma splice.
entries.practice: Repair a comma splice in two ways. Xato ulangan gapni ikki usulda tuzating.

entries.title: Writing Task 1 — Line Graph
entries.explanationEn: Describe the overall trends first, then compare selected starting/ending values, turning points and major gaps. Preserve dates, units and the scale.
entries.explanationUz: Avval umumiy tendensiyani ayting. Keyin boshlanish, yakun, burilish va katta farqlarni tanlab solishtiring. Sana, birlik va masshtabni saqlang.
entries.example: Original data: cyclists rose from 40 in 2020 to 90 in 2024; bus users stayed near 120. Overview: cycling increased while bus use was broadly stable.
entries.pitfall: Do not list every point or invent a reason for a change.
entries.practice: Write an overview and one supported numerical comparison. Umumiy xulosa va bitta raqamli solishtirish yozing.

entries.title: Writing Task 1 — Bar Chart
entries.explanationEn: Group comparable categories and report the largest, smallest and meaningful differences. A static chart calls for comparisons, not an invented time trend.
entries.explanationUz: O‘xshash toifalarni guruhlang, eng katta, eng kichik va muhim farqlarni yozing. Vaqt ko‘rsatilmagan diagrammaga vaqt tendensiyasini qo‘shmang.
entries.example: Original data: reading 60%, sport 30%, music 10%. Reading was twice as common as sport in this sample.
entries.pitfall: Distinguish a percentage-point gap from a percentage increase.
entries.practice: Compare two categories and state the unit. Ikki toifani birlik bilan solishtiring.

entries.title: Writing Task 1 — Pie Chart
entries.explanationEn: Describe dominant and minor shares and meaningful changes across charts. Use the same denominator when comparing proportions.
entries.explanationUz: Asosiy va kichik ulushlarni, bir necha diagrammada esa muhim o‘zgarishni ayting. Ulushlar taqqoslanganda umumiy asos bir xil bo‘lsin.
entries.example: Original shares: rent 50%, food 30%, travel 20%. Rent accounted for half of the budget, exceeding food by 20 percentage points.
entries.pitfall: A 20-point difference is not automatically a 20% relative increase.
entries.practice: Summarise the largest share and one comparison. Eng katta ulush va bir solishtirish yozing.

entries.title: Writing Task 1 — Table
entries.explanationEn: Look for groups, extremes and exceptions before selecting figures. Check row/column headings and units so that a comparison refers to the same measure.
entries.explanationUz: Raqam tanlashdan oldin guruhlar, eng yuqori/past qiymat va istisnoni toping. Bir xil o‘lchovni taqqoslayotganingizni sarlavha va birlikdan tekshiring.
entries.example: Original table: town A, 12 minutes; town B, 18 minutes; town C, 30 minutes. A had the shortest journey, while C took two and a half times as long.
entries.pitfall: Do not turn each table cell into a separate sentence.
entries.practice: Write one overview and group two related rows. Umumiy xulosa yozib, mos qatorlarni guruhlang.

entries.title: Writing Task 1 — Mixed Charts
entries.explanationEn: Give an integrated overview and explain relevant links between the visuals. Keep different units distinct and only connect measures when the data support the link.
entries.explanationUz: Birlashtirilgan umumiy xulosa bering. Turli birliklarni ajrating va ko‘rsatkichlarni faqat ma’lumot bog‘lashga imkon bersa ulang.
entries.example: Original visuals: visitor numbers rose, while the share using cars fell. These can be described together without assuming that the absolute number of car visitors fell.
entries.pitfall: A falling percentage can coexist with a rising absolute count.
entries.practice: Explain one supported relationship between two visuals. Ikki tasvir orasidagi asosli bog‘lanishni yozing.

entries.title: Writing Task 1 — Process
entries.explanationEn: Identify the start, end and main stages. Follow the shown order, describe essential inputs/outputs and use passive forms when the process, not the actor, is central.
entries.explanationUz: Boshlanish, yakun va asosiy bosqichlarni toping. Ko‘rsatilgan tartib, kiruvchi va chiquvchi mahsulotlarni ayting. Zarur bo‘lsa passive ishlating.
entries.example: Original process: rainwater is collected, filtered and stored. It then passes through a final filter before use.
entries.pitfall: Do not add unshown machinery or causes.
entries.practice: Describe a three-stage process with sequence markers. Uch bosqichli jarayon yozing.

entries.title: Writing Task 1 — Maps
entries.explanationEn: Summarise the overall transformation, then organise changes by area or function. Distinguish features added, removed, expanded and relocated.
entries.explanationUz: Umumiy o‘zgarishni ayting, keyin hudud yoki vazifa bo‘yicha tartiblang. Qo‘shilgan, olib tashlangan, kengaygan va ko‘chgan joylarni ajrating.
entries.example: Original maps: a car park east of the library was replaced by a garden, while the library building stayed in the same place.
entries.pitfall: Do not invent compass directions when the source does not establish them.
entries.practice: Describe one replacement and one unchanged feature. Almashgan va o‘zgarmagan joydan bittadan yozing.

entries.title: Writing Task 2 — Opinion
entries.explanationEn: Answer the precise opinion question with a clear position. Develop each main reason with explanation and a relevant example, and keep the conclusion consistent.
entries.explanationUz: Aniq savolga ravshan pozitsiya bilan javob bering. Har sababni tushuntirish va mos misol bilan rivojlantiring. Xulosa shu fikrga mos bo‘lsin.
entries.example: Original claim: cities should improve buses. Reason: frequent services reduce waiting. Example: workers on early shifts can reach jobs without owning a car.
entries.pitfall: A memorised introduction cannot replace a relevant argument.
entries.practice: Write a position and one developed supporting paragraph. Pozitsiya va rivojlantirilgan bir paragraf yozing.

entries.title: Writing Task 2 — Discuss Both Views
entries.explanationEn: Explain both views fairly and give your own opinion when asked. Show why someone could hold each view before evaluating the stronger position.
entries.explanationUz: Har ikki qarashni adolatli tushuntiring. So‘ralgan bo‘lsa o‘z fikringizni ham ayting. Baholashdan oldin har tomonning sababini oching.
entries.example: Original topic: shared study rooms versus studying alone. Shared rooms allow peer questions; studying alone can reduce interruptions. Choose a position with reasons.
entries.pitfall: Do not replace the opposing view with an obviously weak version.
entries.practice: Develop one reason for each view, then state your opinion. Ikki tomon sababini va o‘z fikringizni yozing.

entries.title: Writing Task 2 — Advantages/Disadvantages
entries.explanationEn: Cover both required sides. If asked whether benefits outweigh drawbacks, compare their importance or extent instead of merely counting points.
entries.explanationUz: So‘ralgan har ikki tomonni qamrang. Outweigh so‘ralsa, fikrlar sonini emas, ularning ahamiyati yoki ta’sirini taqqoslang.
entries.example: Original topic: online courses. Flexibility can help workers; limited live interaction can make immediate clarification harder. Explain which matters more in the stated context.
entries.pitfall: Two advantages do not automatically outweigh one serious drawback.
entries.practice: Write one benefit, one drawback and a reasoned judgement. Afzallik, kamchilik va asosli xulosa yozing.

entries.title: Writing Task 2 — Problems/Causes/Solutions
entries.explanationEn: Identify exactly whether the prompt asks for causes, problems, solutions or effects. Link each proposed solution to a stated mechanism or cause.
entries.explanationUz: Savol sabab, muammo, yechim yoki oqibatdan nimani so‘rayotganini aniqlang. Har yechimni muammoning mexanizmi yoki sababiga bog‘lang.
entries.example: Original cause: unreliable buses encourage car use. Linked solution: a reliable timetable makes the alternative more practical.
entries.pitfall: A generic demand to raise awareness may not address the stated cause.
entries.practice: Write one cause and a directly connected solution. Sabab va unga mos yechim yozing.

entries.title: Writing Task 2 — Two-Part Questions
entries.explanationEn: Separate the two explicit questions and plan an answer to each. Develop both parts and check that the conclusion does not ignore either.
entries.explanationUz: Ikki savolni ajratib, har biriga javob rejalang. Ikkalasini ham rivojlantiring va xulosada birini tashlab ketmang.
entries.example: Original prompt: Why do people learn online, and how can teachers support them? Explain flexibility, then discuss support such as clear schedules and feedback.
entries.pitfall: A strong answer to the first question does not compensate for omitting the second.
entries.practice: Underline both questions and draft a topic sentence for each. Har savolga asosiy gap yozing.

entries.title: Writing Task 2 — Positive/Negative Development
entries.explanationEn: Make a judgement about the development and explain the criteria behind it. Weigh consequences rather than writing an unrelated list of pros and cons.
entries.explanationUz: O‘zgarish haqida xulosa qilib, uning mezonlarini tushuntiring. Aloqasiz afzallik-kamchilik sanog‘i o‘rniga oqibatlarni baholang.
entries.example: Original development: more libraries offer evening access. A positive judgement could be supported by access for people who work during the day.
entries.pitfall: Keep the judgement consistent unless you explicitly explain a qualified position.
entries.practice: Judge one change and support it with a concrete consequence. Bir o‘zgarishni oqibati bilan baholang.

entries.title: Writing Translation Check
entries.explanationEn: Compare the learner version with the source meaning, including time, quantity, negation and emphasis. A reference translation is one possible wording, not the only valid answer.
entries.explanationUz: Tarjimada zamon, miqdor, inkor va urg‘u saqlanganini tekshiring. Namuna tarjima yagona to‘g‘ri ibora emas.
entries.example: Original source: U hali kelmadi. One natural version: He has not arrived yet. He never arrives changes the meaning.
entries.pitfall: Do not reject an accurate paraphrase merely because it differs from the sample.
entries.practice: Translate a sentence and explain one meaning choice. Gapni tarjima qilib, bir tanlovni izohlang.

entries.title: Writing Vocabulary Activation
entries.explanationEn: Use the target word in its intended sense with a suitable form and collocation. A sentence should establish a meaningful context, not merely contain the spelling.
entries.explanationUz: So‘zni ko‘zlangan ma’noda, mos shakl va birikmada ishlating. Gap so‘zning yozilishinigina emas, ma’noli vaziyatni ko‘rsatsin.
entries.example: Target bank: a financial institution. Example: She deposited her wages in the bank. A grassy river bank uses a different sense.
entries.pitfall: Word presence does not verify the intended sense.
entries.practice: Write a new context for a chosen sense. Tanlangan ma’noga mos yangi vaziyat yozing.

entries.title: Writing Pattern Adaptation
entries.explanationEn: Keep the useful grammatical relationship while changing the content meaningfully. Check that the new subjects, verbs and references remain compatible.
entries.explanationUz: Foydali grammatik munosabatni saqlab, mazmunni yangilang. Yangi ega, fe’l va ishoralar bir-biriga mos bo‘lsin.
entries.example: Pattern: Although X is costly, it saves time. Adaptation: Although the train is expensive, it saves me an hour.
entries.pitfall: Replacing nouns mechanically can produce an illogical contrast.
entries.practice: Adapt a contrast pattern to your own study routine. Zidlik qolipini o‘qish odatingizga moslang.

entries.title: Speaking Part 1
entries.explanationEn: Answer the personal question directly, then add a reason or a small relevant detail. Natural development matters more than a memorised long speech.
entries.explanationUz: Shaxsiy savolga bevosita javob bering, keyin sabab yoki mos tafsilot qo‘shing. Yodlangan uzun nutqdan ko‘ra tabiiy rivojlantirish muhim.
entries.example: Question: Do you like your neighbourhood? Example: Yes, especially in the morning, because the streets are quiet and I can walk to the library.
entries.pitfall: Do not force an unrelated story into every short question.
entries.practice: Answer a familiar question with an answer and reason. Tanish savolga javob va sabab bering.

entries.title: Speaking Part 2
entries.explanationEn: Use the cue card to organise a connected account. Develop concrete details and explain why the event, person or object matters to you.
entries.explanationUz: Cue card asosida bog‘langan hikoya tuzing. Aniq tafsilotlar va voqea, inson yoki narsaning siz uchun ahamiyatini oching.
entries.example: Original plan for a useful object: an old notebook -> who gave it -> how I use it -> why its notes matter.
entries.pitfall: A list of cue-card bullet answers may lack a connected account.
entries.practice: Plan four linked points about a useful object. Foydali narsa haqida to‘rtta bog‘langan fikr tuzing.

entries.title: Speaking Part 3
entries.explanationEn: Discuss broader ideas with a claim, explanation and relevant example. Qualify generalisations and consider conditions or another perspective.
entries.explanationUz: Kengroq fikrni da’vo, izoh va misol bilan oching. Keskin umumlashtirishni yumshatib, shart yoki boshqa qarashni ko‘rib chiqing.
entries.example: Original question: Why do cities need public spaces? Claim: they support interaction. Explanation: people can meet without paying for a private venue.
entries.pitfall: Avoid saying all people behave the same way without support.
entries.practice: Give a claim, reason and qualification about a city issue. Shahar masalasida fikr, sabab va cheklov ayting.

entries.title: Speaking Full Mock
entries.explanationEn: Practise the progression from personal questions to a sustained individual answer and a broader discussion. Keep observations separate for content, organisation and language.
entries.explanationUz: Shaxsiy savoldan davomli javobga va kengroq muhokamaga o‘tishni mashq qiling. Mazmun, tartib va til haqidagi kuzatuvlarni ajrating.
entries.example: Original practice sequence: your reading habits -> describe a useful book -> discuss how libraries can serve communities.
entries.pitfall: A transcript alone cannot establish pronunciation quality.
entries.practice: Record a practice sequence, then compare your transcript with the recording. Yozuv va transkriptni solishtiring.

entries.title: Speaking Coach Answer
entries.explanationEn: Improve an answer by clarifying its message, adding a relevant reason and replacing unclear wording. Preserve the learner’s intended meaning.
entries.explanationUz: Javobning ma’nosini aniqlashtiring, mos sabab qo‘shing va noaniq iborani tuzating. O‘quvchining asl ma’nosini saqlang.
entries.example: Short answer: I like the park. Expanded example: I like the park because its paths are quiet, so I can think while I walk.
entries.pitfall: Do not invent personal experiences for the learner or claim audio-based judgements from text.
entries.practice: Expand a short answer with one real reason. Qisqa javobni bitta haqiqiy sabab bilan kengaytiring.

entries.title: Reading TRUE/FALSE/NOT GIVEN
entries.explanationEn: TRUE means the statement agrees with the text. FALSE needs a contradiction. NOT GIVEN means the text does not settle the claim. Use textual evidence, not outside knowledge.
entries.explanationUz: TRUE matnga mos keladi. FALSE uchun qarama-qarshi dalil kerak. NOT GIVEN da matn da’voni hal qilmaydi. Tashqi bilimga tayanmang.
entries.example: Original text: The clinic opens at nine on weekdays. Claim: It opens at ten on weekdays -> FALSE. Claim: It opens on Sunday -> NOT GIVEN.
entries.pitfall: Not mentioned is not the same as contradicted.
entries.practice: Create one contradicted claim and one undecided claim from the text. Bitta FALSE va bitta NOT GIVEN da’vo tuzing.

entries.title: Reading YES/NO/NOT GIVEN
entries.explanationEn: Compare a statement with the writer’s view or claim. YES agrees, NO contradicts, and NOT GIVEN means that view is not established by the text.
entries.explanationUz: Da’voni muallif fikri bilan solishtiring. YES moslik, NO zidlik, NOT GIVEN esa bu fikr matnda aniqlanmaganini bildiradi.
entries.example: Original writer: Expanding libraries is a better use of funds than adding parking. Claim: The writer prefers spending on parking -> NO.
entries.pitfall: Do not replace the writer’s view with your own opinion.
entries.practice: Explain the phrase that shows the writer’s position. Muallif pozitsiyasini ko‘rsatgan iborani izohlang.

entries.title: Reading Matching Headings
entries.explanationEn: Choose a heading for the paragraph’s central purpose, not a striking example or repeated word. Summarise the whole paragraph before comparing headings.
entries.explanationUz: Paragrafning bir misoli yoki takroriy so‘zini emas, asosiy vazifasini toping. Sarlavhalarni tanlashdan oldin butun paragrafni qisqa jamlang.
entries.example: Original paragraph explains how tree shade lowers pavement heat, then gives two street examples. Suitable heading: How trees cool streets.
entries.pitfall: A detail about one street may be too narrow for the whole paragraph.
entries.practice: Write a five-word summary before selecting a heading. Avval qisqa asosiy fikr yozing.

entries.title: Reading Matching Information
entries.explanationEn: Locate the requested detail or function, such as an example, comparison or explanation. The right paragraph may contain a paraphrase rather than the question’s words.
entries.explanationUz: So‘ralgan tafsilot yoki vazifani toping: misol, taqqoslash yoki izoh. Mos paragrafda savolning aynan so‘zlari emas, qayta ifodasi bo‘lishi mumkin.
entries.example: Original request: a reason a plan was delayed. Evidence: The work began later because materials arrived late.
entries.pitfall: Match the complete requested information, not one shared word.
entries.practice: Identify the exact evidence span for a requested reason. Sababni tasdiqlovchi qismini toping.

entries.title: Reading Matching Features
entries.explanationEn: Track which person, group or category is linked to each claim. Separate a view someone reports from a view they personally endorse.
entries.explanationUz: Har fikr qaysi inson yoki toifaga tegishli ekanini kuzating. Odam keltirgan boshqa fikrni uning o‘z qarashi deb olmang.
entries.example: Original text: Ali favours smaller classes. Dina favours longer lessons. Statement: supports reducing class size -> Ali.
entries.pitfall: Do not assign every nearby claim to the nearest name.
entries.practice: Make a person-to-claim table using only stated links. Faqat matndagi bog‘lanishlarni jadvalga yozing.

entries.title: Reading Matching Sentence Endings
entries.explanationEn: Use the passage to match the intended meaning, then check grammar across the sentence boundary. A grammatically possible ending may still be unsupported.
entries.explanationUz: Avval matndagi ma’noga mos yakunni tanlang, keyin butun gap grammatikasini tekshiring. Grammatik moslikning o‘zi yetmaydi.
entries.example: Original text: Improved insulation reduced the building’s energy use. Start: The building used less energy because... Ending: its insulation was improved.
entries.pitfall: Do not choose an ending only because it forms a natural sentence.
entries.practice: Explain both the evidence and the completed sentence’s meaning. Dalil va to‘liq gap ma’nosini ayting.

entries.title: Reading MCQ Single
entries.explanationEn: Find the text supporting the complete option and reject distractors that change time, cause, quantity or certainty. Select the requested number of answers.
entries.explanationUz: Variantning butun mazmunini tasdiqlovchi dalilni toping. Vaqt, sabab, miqdor yoki ishonchni o‘zgartirgan chalg‘ituvchini rad eting.
entries.example: Original text: Improved insulation reduced heating costs. Supported: insulation helped reduce heating costs. Unsupported: costs disappeared completely.
entries.pitfall: One matching word does not validate an entire option.
entries.practice: For each option, identify support or one precise mismatch. Har variantga dalil yoki aniq xato toping.

entries.title: Reading MCQ Multiple
entries.explanationEn: Treat each option as a separate claim and verify every selected option. Follow the instruction’s required number of choices.
entries.explanationUz: Har variantni alohida da’vo deb tekshiring. Tanlovlar soni topshiriq ko‘rsatmasiga mos bo‘lsin.
entries.example: Original text: The course offers evening classes and online notes, but no weekend sessions. Supported benefits: evening classes and online notes.
entries.pitfall: Do not stop after finding one true option when two are required.
entries.practice: Write a support phrase for every selected option. Har tanlangan variantga dalil yozing.

entries.title: Reading Sentence Completion
entries.explanationEn: Predict the grammatical type of the gap, locate the relevant wording and obey the stated word limit. Preserve the passage’s required form.
entries.explanationUz: Bo‘shliqning grammatik turini taxmin qiling, mos iborani toping va so‘z chegarasiga rioya qiling. Kerakli so‘z shaklini saqlang.
entries.example: Original text: The roof collects rainwater. Gap: The roof collects _____. With a one-word limit: rainwater.
entries.pitfall: Extra articles can break a one-word limit.
entries.practice: Check meaning, grammar and the word count. Ma’no, grammatika va so‘z sonini tekshiring.

entries.title: Reading Summary Completion
entries.explanationEn: Follow the summary’s argument and locate its corresponding passage section. Check whether answers come from the passage or a supplied list.
entries.explanationUz: Summary mantiqini kuzatib, matnning mos qismini toping. Javob matndan olinadimi yoki berilgan ro‘yxatdanmi, aniqlang.
entries.example: Original text: Shade lowered surface temperatures. Summary: Tree shade reduced surface _____. One-word answer: temperatures.
entries.pitfall: Do not transfer an idea from a different part merely because its word fits.
entries.practice: Map each gap to a supporting sentence. Har bo‘shliqni dalil gapiga bog‘lang.

entries.title: Reading Note Completion
entries.explanationEn: Use headings and note structure to locate the relevant information. Check parallel categories and the grammatical form each gap needs.
entries.explanationUz: Sarlavha va konspekt tuzilishidan foydalaning. Yonma-yon toifalar va bo‘shliqqa kerakli shaklni tekshiring.
entries.example: Original text: The workshop provides gloves and masks. Notes: Equipment supplied: gloves and _____. Answer: masks.
entries.pitfall: An omitted verb in notes does not license an invented answer.
entries.practice: Locate the list in the source and copy the needed item. Manbadagi ro‘yxatdan kerakli so‘zni oling.

entries.title: Reading Table Completion
entries.explanationEn: Read row and column labels before locating the value. Match the correct category, unit and comparison period.
entries.explanationUz: Avval qator va ustun nomlarini o‘qing. To‘g‘ri toifa, birlik va davrga mos qiymatni toping.
entries.example: Original text: The north route takes 12 minutes; the south route takes 20. Table row north, time in minutes -> 12.
entries.pitfall: Do not place a correct value in the wrong row.
entries.practice: Verify the row label and unit for every gap. Har bo‘shliqning qatori va birligini tekshiring.

entries.title: Reading Flow-chart Completion
entries.explanationEn: Trace the stated sequence and locate the step between its neighbours. Use the instructions to decide whether to choose or copy words.
entries.explanationUz: Ko‘rsatilgan ketma-ketlikni kuzatib, bosqichni ikki yonidagi ish orasidan toping. So‘zni tanlash yoki ko‘chirish kerakligini ko‘rsatmadan biling.
entries.example: Original sequence: sort paper -> remove metal -> press sheets. The step after sorting is removing metal.
entries.pitfall: Do not add a plausible process stage absent from the passage.
entries.practice: Explain why the chosen step belongs at that position. Bosqich o‘rnini dalil bilan izohlang.

entries.title: Reading Diagram Label
entries.explanationEn: Locate the source description and map its spatial relationships to the diagram. Check the arrow’s endpoint and required label form.
entries.explanationUz: Manbadagi tavsifni topib, joylashuv munosabatlarini diagrammaga ko‘chiring. Strelka uchi va yoziladigan shaklni tekshiring.
entries.example: Original description: A filter sits above the storage tank. A label pointing to the upper component is filter, not tank.
entries.pitfall: A nearby object may not be the one the arrow identifies.
entries.practice: Trace each arrow before choosing the source phrase. Strelka qaysi qismga ketganini tekshiring.

entries.title: Reading Short Answer
entries.explanationEn: Answer the precise question from the relevant text and stay within the word limit. Check whether it asks who, where, when, how many or why.
entries.explanationUz: Savolning aniq turiga matndan javob bering. Kim, qayerda, qachon, nechta yoki nima sababdan so‘ralganini va so‘z chegarasini tekshiring.
entries.example: Original text: The team met at the library. Question: Where did the team meet? A two-word limit permits the library.
entries.pitfall: Do not answer a location question with a time or a full unrelated sentence.
entries.practice: Underline the question word and identify the matching fact. Savol so‘zi va mos faktni toping.

entries.title: Listening MCQ Single
entries.explanationEn: Listen for the speaker’s final intended meaning and compare complete options. A repeated option word can be a distractor, correction or rejected suggestion.
entries.explanationUz: Gapiruvchining yakuniy ma’nosini tinglang va to‘liq variantlarni solishtiring. Takrorlangan so‘z chalg‘ituvchi, tuzatish yoki rad etilgan taklif bo‘lishi mumkin.
entries.example: Original script: We considered Friday, but the tutor is busy, so the session is on Monday. Correct day: Monday.
entries.pitfall: Do not select the first day mentioned.
entries.practice: Mark the correction and the final decision. Tuzatish va yakuniy qarorni ajrating.

entries.title: Listening MCQ Multiple
entries.explanationEn: Check each option against what is actually included, recommended or decided. Follow the requested number of answers and track negatives.
entries.explanationUz: Har variant haqiqatan kiritilganmi, tavsiya etilganmi yoki tanlanganmi, tekshiring. Kerakli son va inkorlarga e’tibor bering.
entries.example: Original script: The fee covers materials and lunch, but transport is separate. Included: materials and lunch.
entries.pitfall: Mentioning transport does not mean it is included.
entries.practice: Give evidence for both selected options. Har tanlovni tasdiqlovchi iborani toping.

entries.title: Listening Form Completion
entries.explanationEn: Use the field label to predict the kind of information, then listen for spelling, numbers and corrections. Keep to the stated format.
entries.explanationUz: Maydon nomidan kerakli ma’lumot turini biling. Imlo, raqam va tuzatishni tinglang. So‘ralgan formatni saqlang.
entries.example: Original script: The booking is under Lina, spelled L-I-N-A. Name field: Lina.
entries.pitfall: Do not assume a familiar spelling when the speaker spells a name.
entries.practice: Practise spelling a short name from a script. Qisqa ismni harflab yozishni mashq qiling.

entries.title: Listening Note Completion
entries.explanationEn: Follow the note headings, predict the missing grammatical type and listen for paraphrases. Notes may omit function words, but the answer must still fit.
entries.explanationUz: Konspekt sarlavhasini kuzating, bo‘shliq turini biling va qayta ifodalarni tinglang. Konspekt qisqa bo‘lsa ham javob mos bo‘lishi kerak.
entries.example: Original script: Bring a notebook and a pencil. Note: Bring: notebook and _____. Answer: pencil.
entries.pitfall: Do not copy an entire spoken phrase when one word is required.
entries.practice: Check the final word against the note’s meaning and limit. Ma’no va chegarani tekshiring.

entries.title: Listening Table Completion
entries.explanationEn: Track the row and column while listening. Distinguish values for different groups, dates or locations and pay attention to corrected numbers.
entries.explanationUz: Tinglashda qator va ustunni kuzating. Guruh, sana va joy qiymatlarini ajrating. Tuzatilgan raqamga e’tibor bering.
entries.example: Original script: Group A starts at nine; group B at ten. Row B, starting time -> ten.
entries.pitfall: The right number for group A is still wrong in group B’s row.
entries.practice: Say which category each number belongs to. Har raqamning toifasini yozing.

entries.title: Listening Flow-chart Completion
entries.explanationEn: Follow the described sequence and use transition signals to locate each step. Choose only actions stated in the recording.
entries.explanationUz: Aytilgan ketma-ketlik va o‘tish iboralarini kuzating. Faqat yozuvda aytilgan ishni tanlang.
entries.example: Original script: First register, then collect a badge, and finally enter the hall. Middle step: collect a badge.
entries.pitfall: General knowledge about the process cannot replace the recording.
entries.practice: Reconstruct three stated steps in order. Aytilgan uch bosqichni tartiblang.

entries.title: Listening Sentence Completion
entries.explanationEn: Listen for the idea completing the sentence and the exact needed words. Check grammar, spelling and the instruction’s word limit.
entries.explanationUz: Gapni tugatuvchi fikr va kerakli so‘zlarni tinglang. Grammatika, imlo va so‘z chegarasini tekshiring.
entries.example: Original script: The room is heated using solar energy. Sentence: The room uses _____ energy. Answer: solar.
entries.pitfall: Do not add energy twice if it is already printed after the gap.
entries.practice: Read the whole completed sentence aloud. To‘ldirilgan gapni butun o‘qing.

entries.title: Listening Short Answer
entries.explanationEn: Identify what the question asks and record the relevant spoken fact concisely. Follow the word and number limits exactly.
entries.explanationUz: Savol nimani so‘rayotganini aniqlab, mos aytilgan faktni qisqa yozing. So‘z va raqam chegarasini saqlang.
entries.example: Original script: The meeting takes place in Room 12. Question: Which room? Answer in the required format: Room 12.
entries.pitfall: Do not add an explanation when the task needs only an identifier.
entries.practice: Match who/where/when to the right spoken fact. Savol turiga mos faktni tanlang.

entries.title: Listening Map/Plan Labelling
entries.explanationEn: Establish the starting point and orientation, then follow direction and position phrases. Distinguish the speaker’s movement from locations on the plan.
entries.explanationUz: Boshlanish nuqtasi va yo‘nalishni aniqlang. Harakat va joylashuv iboralarini kuzating. Gapiruvchining yurishi bilan xaritadagi joyni ajrating.
entries.example: Original plan: enter at the south door; the desk is immediately on your left. Identify the desk relative to that entrance.
entries.pitfall: Left depends on the stated orientation, not your guess.
entries.practice: Draw a route from a fixed entrance using two directions. Belgilangan kirishdan ikki yo‘nalishli yo‘l chizing.

entries.title: Listening Matching
entries.explanationEn: Track the relationship between each item and the descriptions. Watch for contrasts, rejected options and whether options may be reused.
entries.explanationUz: Har narsa bilan uning tavsifi orasidagi bog‘lanishni kuzating. Zidlik, rad etilgan variant va variantni qayta ishlatish ko‘rsatmasini tekshiring.
entries.example: Original script: The morning tour focuses on gardens; the afternoon tour focuses on historic buildings. Match afternoon -> historic buildings.
entries.pitfall: Do not attach a later speaker’s preference to the earlier item.
entries.practice: Write one evidence phrase beside each match. Har moslikka bitta dalil iborasi yozing.

entries.title: Grammar Error Correction
entries.explanationEn: Locate the exact error and explain the smallest correction that preserves the intended meaning. Distinguish an error from a possible stylistic alternative.
entries.explanationUz: Aniq xatoni topib, asl ma’noni saqlaydigan eng kichik tuzatishni izohlang. Xato bilan shunchaki boshqa uslubni ajrating.
entries.example: Original error: People is waiting outside. Correction: People are waiting outside. People is plural in this use.
entries.pitfall: Do not rewrite every sentence just to sound different.
entries.practice: Correct one agreement error and state the rule. Bitta moslik xatosini qoida bilan tuzating.

entries.title: Grammar Sentence Transformation
entries.explanationEn: Preserve the specified meaning while meeting the target structure and any word limit. Check tense, agents, negation and reference after changing the form.
entries.explanationUz: Ma’noni saqlab, so‘ralgan tuzilish va chegaraga amal qiling. O‘zgartirgandan keyin zamon, bajaruvchi, inkor va ishoralarni tekshiring.
entries.example: Original: The team built the bridge. Passive: The bridge was built by the team.
entries.pitfall: A grammatical result can still change the original meaning.
entries.practice: Transform one active sentence to passive without changing time. Vaqtni saqlab passive yozing.

entries.title: Grammar Fill Gap
entries.explanationEn: Identify the grammatical relationship around the gap. Use subject, time context and complement pattern together; do not rely on the nearest word alone.
entries.explanationUz: Bo‘shliq atrofidagi grammatik munosabatni aniqlang. Ega, vaqt va fe’l birikmasini birga tekshiring. Faqat eng yaqin so‘zga tayanmang.
entries.example: Original: She ___ to school every day. With the verb walk: walks, because she is third-person singular in a routine.
entries.pitfall: An answer key may permit only the task’s specified forms.
entries.practice: Explain the form needed in a routine sentence. Odat gapiga kerakli shaklni izohlang.

entries.title: Grammar Controlled Production
entries.explanationEn: Produce your own meaningful sentence while satisfying the given structure. Check form and intended meaning separately.
entries.explanationUz: Berilgan tuzilishni saqlab, o‘zingizning ma’noli gapingizni tuzing. Shakl va ko‘zlangan ma’noni alohida tekshiring.
entries.example: Target: although + contrast. Example: Although I was tired, I finished my homework.
entries.pitfall: Inserting although into an unrelated sentence does not establish a contrast.
entries.practice: Use although to express a real contrast. Although bilan haqiqiy zidlik yozing.

entries.title: Grammar Free Production
entries.explanationEn: Choose structures that fit your message and context, then review one grammatical focus at a time. A clean pattern check does not prove that every sentence is accurate.
entries.explanationUz: Fikr va vaziyatga mos tuzilishni tanlang. Keyin bittadan grammatik yo‘nalishni tekshiring. Oddiy tekshiruv barcha gaplar to‘g‘riligini isbotlamaydi.
entries.example: Original task: describe a recent change. Example: I used to travel by car, but I now walk to work.
entries.pitfall: Do not add a target structure when it changes what you mean.
entries.practice: Write three connected sentences about a real change. Haqiqiy o‘zgarish haqida uch bog‘langan gap yozing.

entries.title: Grammar Rule Explanation
entries.explanationEn: Explain meaning, form and use, then contrast a common error with a suitable example. State relevant limits instead of presenting a rough pattern as an exceptionless rule.
entries.explanationUz: Ma’no, shakl va qo‘llanishni tushuntiring. Keyin xato va mos misolni solishtiring. Taxminiy qolipni istisnosiz qoida deb bermang.
entries.example: Original explanation: after did in an ordinary question, use the base verb: Did she go? not Did she went?
entries.pitfall: Choose a specific grammar topic when a question is too broad.
entries.practice: Explain one form using a correct example and a correction. Qoida, to‘g‘ri misol va tuzatish yozing.

entries.title: Grammar Retention Review
entries.explanationEn: Recall a rule without first reading it, produce an example and check it against a trusted reference. Revisit recurring error patterns rather than only rereading notes.
entries.explanationUz: Avval qoidani qaramasdan eslang, misol tuzing va ishonchli namuna bilan tekshiring. Faqat qayta o‘qish o‘rniga qaytalanuvchi xatoni mashq qiling.
entries.example: Original recall cue: after does in a question. Retrieved rule: use the base verb. Example: Does he work here?
entries.pitfall: Remembering a definition is not the same as using the form accurately.
entries.practice: Close your notes and write one new example. Konspektni yopib, yangi misol yozing.

entries.title: Vocabulary Meaning
entries.explanationEn: Explain the selected sense with a clear definition and an example. A word can have several senses, so do not merge meanings simply because the spelling is identical.
entries.explanationUz: Tanlangan ma’noni aniq ta’rif va misol bilan tushuntiring. Bir xil yozilish turli ma’nolarni birlashtirish uchun asos emas.
entries.example: Original contrast: a bank can be a financial institution or the land beside a river. Depositing money identifies the financial sense.
entries.pitfall: An unverified definition must not be presented as a canonical dictionary record.
entries.practice: Give an example that disambiguates one sense. Bir ma’noni aniq qiladigan misol yozing.

entries.title: Vocabulary Contextual Meaning
entries.explanationEn: Use the surrounding sentence to determine the intended sense. Check the action, participants and topic rather than only the target word.
entries.explanationUz: Ko‘zlangan ma’noni atrofdagi gapdan biling. So‘zning o‘zigina emas, harakat, ishtirokchilar va mavzuni tekshiring.
entries.example: Original sentence: They sat on the bank beside the river. Bank here means the river edge, not a financial institution.
entries.pitfall: Word presence alone cannot establish correct sense use.
entries.practice: Underline the context words that identify the sense. Ma’noni aniqlagan so‘zlarni belgilang.

entries.title: Vocabulary Translation
entries.explanationEn: Translate the intended sense and phrase, not an isolated spelling. Preserve register and grammatical role; a single translation may not fit every context.
entries.explanationUz: Alohida yozilishni emas, ko‘zlangan ma’no va iborani tarjima qiling. Uslub va grammatik vazifani saqlang. Bitta tarjima hamma vaziyatga mos emas.
entries.example: Original contrast: light can describe illumination or something not heavy. The sentence determines which translation is appropriate.
entries.pitfall: Do not choose a familiar translation without checking the sentence.
entries.practice: Compare two senses of one word in separate sentences. Bir so‘zning ikki ma’nosini gaplarda solishtiring.

entries.title: Vocabulary Collocation
entries.explanationEn: Learn words with natural partners and the intended sense. Some combinations are conventional even when a different verb seems logically possible.
entries.explanationUz: So‘zni tabiiy sherigi va ma’nosi bilan o‘rganing. Ayrim birikmalar an’anaviy bo‘lib, mantiqan boshqa fe’l mosdek tuyulishi mumkin.
entries.example: Original examples: make a decision; do homework; heavy rain. She made a careful decision.
entries.pitfall: Literal translation can create an unnatural word partnership.
entries.practice: Write a personal sentence with make a decision. Shu birikma bilan shaxsiy gap yozing.

entries.title: Vocabulary Word Form
entries.explanationEn: Choose the grammatical form required by the sentence and check meaning. A noun, verb, adjective and adverb from one family may have different patterns.
entries.explanationUz: Gap talab qilgan grammatik shaklni va ma’noni tekshiring. Bir oiladagi ot, fe’l, sifat va ravish turli qolipda ishlatilishi mumkin.
entries.example: Original family: success, succeed, successful, successfully. The team completed the task successfully.
entries.pitfall: Do not add a suffix without checking the resulting word and its use.
entries.practice: Use success and successful in two sentences. Ikki shaklni o‘rniga mos ishlating.

entries.title: Vocabulary Synonym Choice
entries.explanationEn: Choose a word matching the sense, register and collocation in this sentence. Synonyms are rarely interchangeable in every context.
entries.explanationUz: Shu gapdagi ma’no, uslub va birikmaga mos sinonimni tanlang. Sinonimlar har vaziyatda bir-birini almashtirmaydi.
entries.example: Original contrast: a big mistake and a large building are natural, but large mistake is not the usual partnership.
entries.pitfall: Shared dictionary meaning does not guarantee identical usage.
entries.practice: Explain why a synonym fits one sentence but not another. Sinonimning vaziyatga mosligini izohlang.

entries.title: Vocabulary Paraphrase
entries.explanationEn: Restate the same meaning using a suitable change in wording or structure. Preserve quantity, certainty, time and cause instead of mechanically replacing each word.
entries.explanationUz: Bir xil ma’noni mos so‘z yoki tuzilish bilan qayta ayting. Miqdor, ishonch, vaqt va sababni saqlang. Har so‘zni majburan almashtirmang.
entries.example: Original: The number of cyclists increased. Paraphrase: More people travelled by bicycle. Context must support the same population and period.
entries.pitfall: May increase and will increase express different certainty.
entries.practice: Paraphrase a short claim and check what stayed the same. Qisqa fikrni ma’nosini saqlab qayta yozing.

entries.title: Vocabulary Activation
entries.explanationEn: Move from recognising a word to retrieving it in a meaningful context. Select the intended sense, use a natural form and review the sentence against that definition.
entries.explanationUz: So‘zni tanishdan ma’noli vaziyatda eslab qo‘llashga o‘ting. Ma’no va mos shaklni tanlab, gapni ta’rif bilan solishtiring.
entries.example: Target reliable: consistently dependable. Original example: A reliable timetable helps me plan my journey.
entries.pitfall: Copying the example does not demonstrate independent productive use.
entries.practice: Write a new situation for reliable. Reliable uchun yangi vaziyat yozing.

aliases: use a word in a sentence
entries.title: Vocabulary Productive Use
entries.explanationEn: Use a word to communicate a specific idea rather than to display its spelling. Check its sense, grammatical role, collocation and surrounding context.
entries.explanationUz: So‘zning yozilishinigina ko‘rsatish emas, aniq fikrni yetkazish uchun ishlating. Ma’no, vazifa, birikma va kontekstni tekshiring.
entries.example: Original example: The repair was expensive, but it made the bicycle reliable again.
entries.pitfall: A complete sentence can still use a word in the wrong sense.
entries.practice: Use a target word with a reason or consequence. So‘zni sabab yoki oqibat bilan ishlating.

entries.title: Retention Reading Recall
entries.explanationEn: Recall the passage’s central claim and supporting details, then compare your recall with the source. Mark additions and omissions separately.
entries.explanationUz: Asosiy fikr va dalillarni eslab yozing, keyin manba bilan solishtiring. Qo‘shib yuborilgan va tushib qolgan ma’lumotni ajrating.
entries.example: Original source: Shade reduced heat on two streets. Recall: Trees cooled every street invents a broader result.
entries.pitfall: Fluent recall can still contain invented facts.
entries.practice: Recall a short paragraph, then check each claim. Qisqa matnni eslab, da’volarni tekshiring.

entries.title: Retention Vocabulary Recall
entries.explanationEn: Retrieve the word from a meaning or context cue before checking the answer. Separate recognition, recall and successful use in a new sentence.
entries.explanationUz: Javobga qarashdan oldin ma’no yoki vaziyatdan so‘zni eslang. Tanish, eslash va yangi gapda ishlatishni ajrating.
entries.example: Original cue: dependable over time. Possible target: reliable. Then write a new sentence to show the intended sense.
entries.pitfall: Recognising an answer among options does not prove free recall.
entries.practice: Hide the target, retrieve it and use it in a fresh context. So‘zni yashirib, eslab yangi gapda qo‘llang.

entries.title: Retention Error Pattern
entries.explanationEn: Group repeated errors by a useful rule, practise a contrasting example and revisit the pattern later. Keep the original evidence separate from an inferred cause.
entries.explanationUz: Takroriy xatolarni mos qoida bo‘yicha guruhlang. Farqli misolni mashq qilib, keyin qayta tekshiring. Dalil bilan taxminiy sababni ajrating.
entries.example: Original errors: Did she went? Did he saw? Shared pattern: after did use the base verb.
entries.pitfall: Two errors do not prove a learner’s motive or permanent ability.
entries.practice: Write three correct did-questions with different verbs. Turli fe’llarda uch to‘g‘ri savol yozing.

entries.title: General Simple Explanation
entries.explanationEn: Start with the learner’s specific question. Give one clear rule or idea, a short example and a small next action. State missing context when needed.
entries.explanationUz: Aniq savoldan boshlang. Bitta tushunarli qoida, qisqa misol va kichik keyingi mashq bering. Kontekst yetishmasa ayting.
entries.example: Original mini-lesson: After does, use the base verb. Does she work? Now make a question with study.
entries.pitfall: Do not pretend that a brief rule covers every exception.
entries.practice: Explain one idea in two sentences and add one practice cue. Ikki gap va bitta mashq bilan izohlang.

entries.title: General Compare Concepts
entries.explanationEn: Compare the concepts on a common dimension, explain the difference and use paired examples. If either concept is unspecified, ask for the missing context rather than inventing it.
entries.explanationUz: Tushunchalarni umumiy mezonda solishtiring. Farqni ikki mos misol bilan oching. Tushuncha noaniq bo‘lsa uni o‘ylab topmang.
entries.example: Original contrast: I saw her yesterday places the event in finished time. I have seen her before gives experience up to now.
entries.pitfall: Two definitions alone may not explain when to choose each form.
entries.practice: Write paired examples showing one meaningful difference. Bitta farqni ko‘rsatadigan ikki misol yozing.

entries.title: Progress/Report Explanation
entries.explanationEn: Explain only the metrics and period actually present in an authorised report. Distinguish a saved result, a trend supported by comparable observations and an uncertain interpretation.
entries.explanationUz: Faqat ruxsat etilgan hisobotdagi davr va o‘lchovlarni izohlang. Saqlangan natija, mos kuzatuvlar ko‘rsatgan tendensiya va taxminni ajrating.
entries.example: Original example: Two recorded sessions were completed this week. That count alone does not prove a rise in language proficiency.
entries.pitfall: Do not invent marks, trends or another learner’s results.
entries.practice: Explain a displayed count and name one conclusion it cannot support. Ko‘rsatilgan sondan kelmaydigan xulosani ayting.
